svg.title: Tasman Front: OSW editorial reference-route candidate
svg.desc: Equirectangular schematic. Approximately 1700 km. Historical Tasman Front naming convention represented by an OSW offshore 154 E to 172 E near-34 S regional connection. Gates truncate the Australia-northern-New-Zealand geography; neither coastal endpoints nor a continuously identifiable jet is claimed. Excludes coastal EAC, southern extension and East Auckland coastal continuation. Source describes regional geography; OSW selects the drawn route. No measured current axis.
svg.text: OSW approximate historical Tasman reference connection — candidate
Dashed: nominal route · pale: 81 editorial scenarios
Not an observed axis or statistical confidence interval
Source: Tomczak and Godfrey, ch8 pp127-129; OSW selects vertices
Equirectangular OSW atlas ground · scientific review pending
